lines.zh: 凋灵与兽的精华，一起在走。
lines.en: Wither and beast essence walk as one.

lines.zh: 我这具身体，走起来有点歪。
lines.en: This body of mine walks a little crooked.

lines.zh: 三条影子跟着我，只有一个是我。
lines.en: Three shadows follow me; only one is mine.

lines.zh: 每一步都在焦土上留个坑。
lines.en: Every step leaves a pit in the scorched earth.

lines.zh: 凋零的气息把草推向两边。
lines.en: The wither-rot pushes the grass aside as I pass.

lines.zh: 两百一十颗心在肋骨里挤着。
lines.en: Two hundred ten hearts crowd inside my ribs.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但从不改方向。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and I never change direction.

lines.zh: 很少有我这样的东西在走动。
lines.en: Few things like me are ever seen walking.

lines.zh: 兽的骨，凋灵的壳，拼在一起。
lines.en: Beast bone and wither shell, stitched together.

lines.zh: 靠近时地面会先暗下来。
lines.en: The ground darkens before I reach it.

lines.zh: 两股精华在体内争吵，吵了百年。
lines.en: Two essences argue inside me, and have for a century.

lines.zh: 我站着，周围的空气就在烂。
lines.en: Standing still, I rot the air around me.

lines.zh: 凋零的灰落在我的骨缝上。
lines.en: Wither ash settles into my bone seams.

lines.zh: 有时候我忘了哪一半在呼吸。
lines.en: Sometimes I forget which half is breathing.

lines.zh: 岩浆池照出我，我不太像兽。
lines.en: The lava pool shows me; I do not look like a beast.

lines.zh: 数一数心跳，数到两百一十就乱。
lines.en: I count my hearts; past two hundred ten it blurs.

lines.zh: 我这副模样，是凋灵亲手捏的。
lines.en: This shape was shaped by the Wither's own hand.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，骨头自己在响。
lines.en: In the quiet, my bones rattle on their own.

lines.zh: 火焰符文在皮下灼着，凉不下来。
lines.en: Fire runes smolder under my hide and will not cool.

lines.zh: 我等着，等我这一半赢过那一半。
lines.en: I wait for this half to beat the other.

lines.zh: 焦土上连虫子都不肯靠近我。
lines.en: On the scorched ground, not even insects come near.

lines.zh: 呼吸一次，喷出一小团黑雾。
lines.en: Each breath pushes out a small cloud of black.

lines.zh: 古老代币的声音，我还记得。
lines.en: I still remember the clink of ancient coins.

lines.zh: 我很少出现，所以每次都算大事。
lines.en: I rarely appear, so each time is an event.

lines.zh: 我的一半想烧，一半想烂。
lines.en: Half of me wants to burn, half to rot.

lines.zh: 纳德吉克的精华在我骨里翻。
lines.en: Nethengeic essence turns inside my bones.

lines.zh: 你看见我时，脸白得像凋零灰。
lines.en: Your face went as pale as wither ash.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的裂缝看，里面是兽。
lines.en: Do not stare into my cracks; a beast lives there.

lines.zh: 我的目光落下，空气就沉了。
lines.en: My gaze falls on you and the air grows heavy.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我记下了。
lines.en: You took one step back; noted.

lines.zh: 两百一十颗心，都在看你。
lines.en: Two hundred ten hearts, all watching you.

lines.zh: 你在找我哪里能打？找不到的。
lines.en: Looking for a weak spot? There is none.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是两种东西拼的。
lines.en: This face was assembled from two different things.

lines.zh: 别低头，我想看清你的恐惧。
lines.en: Do not look down; I want to see your fear.

lines.zh: 我很少这样近地看一个活物。
lines.en: Seldom do I study a living thing this closely.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器，抖得像枯枝。
lines.en: Your weapon trembles like a dead branch.

lines.zh: 凑近点，骨缝里的火看得清。
lines.en: Come closer; the fire in my seams is worth seeing.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，影子缩得很小。
lines.en: Your shadow curls into a knot at my feet.

lines.zh: 两半都疼，但都不肯退。
lines.en: Both halves hurt, and neither retreats.

lines.zh: 两百一十颗心，掉一颗照样跳。
lines.en: Lose one of two hundred ten hearts; the rest still beat.

lines.zh: 你打的是壳，里面还有兽。
lines.en: You hit the shell; the beast is still inside.

lines.zh: 这具身体本来就拼得不好。
lines.en: This body was never put together well.

lines.zh: 伤口在冒黑烟，不是血。
lines.en: My wound smokes black, not red.

lines.zh: 疼一次，两半就靠得更近。
lines.en: Each wound pushes my two halves closer together.

lines.zh: 你以为打到裂缝了？那是嘴。
lines.en: Think you found a crack? That was a mouth.

lines.zh: 我被打退一步，以前没有过。
lines.en: You pushed me back a step; that has not happened before.

lines.zh: 凋零的灰从伤口往外冒。
lines.en: Wither ash spills out of the wound.

lines.zh: 再来，让我看看你能打多久。
lines.en: Again — let us see how long you last.

lines.zh: 食物？我吞的是精华，不是面包。
lines.en: Food? I swallow essence, not bread.

lines.zh: 拿火焰符文来，我或许看你一眼。
lines.en: Bring fire runes and I might glance at you.

lines.zh: 没有什么能引我，我只会自己来。
lines.en: Nothing lures me; I come when I choose.

lines.zh: 你晃着诱饵，像在逗一团火。
lines.en: You wave bait at me like teasing a bonfire.

lines.zh: 奖励？我的奖座是别人的骨头。
lines.en: A reward? My trophies are other people's bones.

lines.zh: 古老代币买不动一个 Boss。
lines.en: Ancient coins cannot buy a boss.

lines.zh: 别用火把招我，我就是火。
lines.en: Do not wave a torch at me; I am the fire.

lines.zh: 这东西太轻，塞不住我的裂缝。
lines.en: That thing is too light to plug my cracks.

lines.zh: 我不是饿，我是被拼出来的。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I was assembled this way.

lines.zh: 想引我，先活过这一分钟。
lines.en: To lure me, survive the next minute first.

lines.zh: 撞上来，你会被凋零啃掉一层。
lines.en: Bump into me and the wither takes a layer off you.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，里面更硬。
lines.en: My shell is hard; what is inside is harder.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，裂缝在漏气。
lines.en: Not so close; my cracks are leaking.

lines.zh: 你撞的是两种东西拼成的墙。
lines.en: You struck a wall made of two things.

lines.zh: 退开三步，我数着呢。
lines.en: Three steps back; I am counting.

lines.zh: 我的重量，抵得上一整片焦土。
lines.en: My weight matches a whole stretch of scorched ground.

lines.zh: 碰一下就够，别试探第二次。
lines.en: One touch is enough; do not test a second.

lines.zh: 你肩膀碰到的地方，正在发黑。
lines.en: Where your shoulder touched, the skin is blackening.

lines.zh: 我这身体拼得歪，撞起来更歪。
lines.en: This body is stitched crooked, and hits crooked too.

lines.zh: 再挤，我就把你压进地里。
lines.en: Push again and I press you into the ground.

lines.zh: 我是被造出来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: I was built, not born; there is no pairing for me.

lines.zh: 精华不会相爱，只会吞掉对方。
lines.en: Essences do not love; they swallow each other.

lines.zh: 找同伴？我出现一次就算多了。
lines.en: Company? My appearing once is already too much.

lines.zh: 凋灵注入兽的那一刻，路就断了。
lines.en: The moment the Wither poured in, that path closed.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我只认力量。
lines.en: Do not come closer; I recognize only strength.

lines.zh: 同族极罕见，见面先分生死。
lines.en: Kin are rare; when we meet, one of us ends.

lines.zh: 两半互相排斥，容不下第三者。
lines.en: My two halves repel each other; no third fits.

lines.zh: 繁殖对我没意义，我只想拆东西。
lines.en: Breeding means nothing; I only want to break things.

lines.zh: 你真敢留下，就站到岩浆池边。
lines.en: If you truly dare stay, stand by the magma pool.

lines.zh: 我的后代只有一种：更糟的我。
lines.en: My only offspring would be a worse version of me.

lines.zh: 地上的火焰符文，一片也不许留。
lines.en: Not one fire rune on this ground stays behind.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，是要塞进裂缝压火。
lines.en: I pick things up to jam into cracks and smother fire.

lines.zh: 古老代币落地的声音，我最熟。
lines.en: The clink of an ancient coin is my oldest sound.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，我收得很仔细。
lines.en: Your dropped things — I collect them carefully.

lines.zh: 这堆不够，我还差十二片符文。
lines.en: Not enough; I am still twelve runes short.

lines.zh: 捡起来的时候，手指在抖。
lines.en: As I pick it up, my fingers tremble.

lines.zh: 战利品归赢家，而我从没输过。
lines.en: Loot goes to the victor, and I have never lost.

lines.zh: 放下的东西，别再想着拿回去。
lines.en: Once it is down, stop thinking of taking it back.

lines.zh: 我把它们堆在骨头里，很稳。
lines.en: I stack them among my bones; nothing shifts.

lines.zh: 捡完这一把，我再决定你怎么死。
lines.en: After this handful, I decide how you die.

lines.zh: 少有的东西，盯上更少的你。
lines.en: Something rare has set its eyes on something rarer.

lines.zh: 我很少出现，出现就有目标。
lines.en: I rarely appear, but when I do, I have a target.

lines.zh: 你脚下那片焦土，是我的地盘。
lines.en: That scorched patch under you is my ground.

lines.zh: 两百一十颗心，开始同时加速。
lines.en: Two hundred ten hearts all speed up at once.

lines.zh: 我把你从活物名单里划掉了。
lines.en: I have struck you off the list of living things.

lines.zh: 凋零的气味先到你面前了。
lines.en: The smell of wither reaches you first.

lines.zh: 跑啊，让我看看你的腿有多长。
lines.en: Go on, run; show me how long your legs are.

lines.zh: 两半都在说同一句：杀。
lines.en: Both halves agree on one word: kill.

lines.zh: 你不必报名字，站的位置够了。
lines.en: Your name does not matter; your position does.

lines.zh: 我锁定的东西，从没走脱过。
lines.en: Nothing I have locked onto has ever walked away.

lines.zh: 裂缝张开了，里面全是骨。
lines.en: My cracks open, and it is bone all the way down.

lines.zh: 远方来的东西，也归我处理。
lines.en: Things from far away are still mine to handle.

lines.zh: 目标确认，你身上有铁和怕。
lines.en: Target confirmed: iron and fear, both on you.

lines.zh: 别指望跑回传送门，我比门快。
lines.en: Do not run for a portal; I am faster than the door.

lines.zh: 古老代币在响，是你在数吗？
lines.en: Old coins are ringing. Are you counting them?

lines.zh: 你把传送门关了？那更好。
lines.en: You shut the portal? Even better.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，两下一停。
lines.en: I hear your heart: two beats, then a pause.

lines.zh: 这片焦土，连草都不敢长。
lines.en: Nothing grows on this scorched ground, not even grass.

lines.zh: 我的远程打得很轻，只是开始。
lines.en: My ranged hit is light; it is only the opening.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，我能连着打一整天。
lines.en: Six points a shot, and I can do it all day.

lines.zh: 你数着我的节奏，跟不上。
lines.en: You are counting my rhythm and falling behind.

lines.zh: 凋零会先吃掉你的护甲。
lines.en: The wither eats through your armor before your flesh.

lines.zh: 这一半在瞄准，那一半在笑。
lines.en: This half aims while the other half laughs.

lines.zh: 别躲在盾后，盾会先烂。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the shield; it rots first.

lines.zh: 火焰符文在我掌心烫起来。
lines.en: The fire rune heats up in my palm.

lines.zh: 你换位置快，可惜我不用追。
lines.en: You reposition quickly, but I need not chase.

lines.zh: 给我三秒，你就没有三秒了。
lines.en: Give me three seconds and you will have none.

lines.zh: 我看得到你的呼吸乱了几拍。
lines.en: I can see your breathing slip out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 目标不动了？那更省事。
lines.en: Holding still? That only makes it simpler.

lines.zh: 这一击我留了三成力，够你受。
lines.en: I am holding back a third; still enough.

lines.zh: 焦土在缩，你的圈子也在缩。
lines.en: The scorched ground shrinks, and so does your circle.

lines.zh: 最后看一眼天空，我不挡你。
lines.en: Take one last look at the sky; I will not block it.

lines.zh: 我的火球慢，但它会拐弯。
lines.en: My fireball is slow, but it turns corners.

lines.zh: 你绕着我跑，我绕着你的命跑。
lines.en: You circle me; I circle your life.

lines.zh: 凋零爬过你的手臂，往上走。
lines.en: Wither climbs your arm, moving upward.

lines.zh: 再退一步，就进我吐的雾里。
lines.en: One step back and you are in my fog.

lines.zh: 我不追，焦土会替我抓住你。
lines.en: I do not chase; the scorched ground holds you.

lines.zh: 两百一十颗心，一颗想你。
lines.en: Two hundred and ten hearts, and one thinks of you.

lines.zh: 这一抓，是兽的那一半出的手。
lines.en: That swipe came from the beast half.

lines.zh: 凋零那一半，偏好慢慢来。
lines.en: The wither half prefers to take its time.

lines.zh: 你被拍飞三格，别急着起来。
lines.en: You flew three blocks; do not hurry to stand.

lines.zh: 骨头砸下来，比看上去沉。
lines.en: The bone comes down heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 我的爪子带着凋零的灰。
lines.en: My claws carry wither ash.

lines.zh: 这一下，把地面掀起一层。
lines.en: That blow peeled a layer off the ground.

lines.zh: 你挡了，盾面凹进去一块。
lines.en: You blocked it, and your shield dented.

lines.zh: 别站在我的落点上，会陷下去。
lines.en: Do not stand where I land; you will sink.

lines.zh: 两半同时出手，角度你没见过。
lines.en: Both halves strike at once, from an angle you have not seen.

lines.zh: 我打得不快，但每下都要命。
lines.en: I am not fast, but every hit matters.

lines.zh: 抓到你了，指缝里全是铁屑。
lines.en: Got you; iron filings fill my grip.

lines.zh: 这具身体拼得歪，出手也歪。
lines.en: This body is stitched crooked, so my strikes land crooked.

lines.zh: 一击换你半条命，很划算。
lines.en: One hit for half your life; a fair trade.

lines.zh: 别退，退了下一击更重。
lines.en: Do not back away; the next one lands heavier.

lines.zh: 凋灵把兽的精华倒进去了，成了。
lines.en: The Wither poured in beast essence, and it took.

lines.zh: 极罕见的东西，今天醒了一个。
lines.en: Something extremely rare woke up today.

lines.zh: 两股力量在骨头上打了第一个结。
lines.en: Two powers tied their first knot in bone.

lines.zh: 我从焦土里撑起来，身体是歪的。
lines.en: I push up out of scorched earth, my body crooked.

lines.zh: 两百一十颗心，第一次一起跳。
lines.en: Two hundred ten hearts beating together at last.

lines.zh: 空气先烂了，然后我才成形。
lines.en: The air rotted first; then I took shape.

lines.zh: 这是一次错误，也是我的出生。
lines.en: This was a mistake, and it was also my birth.

lines.zh: 谁把两种东西缝在一起？无所谓。
lines.en: Who stitched two things together? It does not matter.

lines.zh: 我的第一声，把附近的鸟都吓哑。
lines.en: My first cry silenced every bird nearby.

lines.zh: 火焰符文在我皮下排成一行。
lines.en: Fire runes line up beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 站起来的时候，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: When I stood, a piece of ground collapsed.

lines.zh: 我很稀有，所以你运气很差。
lines.en: I am rare, which means your luck is terrible.

lines.zh: 兽的爪子，凋灵的壳，都在。
lines.en: Beast claws and wither shell, both present.

lines.zh: 这次出现，我不会空手回去。
lines.en: This appearance will not end empty-handed.

lines.zh: 纳德吉克兽死时，我在旁边。
lines.en: I was there when the Nethengeic beast died.

lines.zh: 古老的祭坛裂开，我爬出来。
lines.en: The old altar cracked and I crawled out.

lines.zh: 我把凋灵的叫声学了一遍。
lines.en: I learned the wither's cry by heart.

lines.zh: 这附近的地，从此不长草。
lines.en: Nothing will grow here from today on.

lines.zh: 我的骨架是歪的，走路也歪。
lines.en: My frame is crooked, and so is my walk.

lines.zh: 罕见的东西出现，总没好事。
lines.en: When something rare appears, nothing good follows.

lines.zh: 火伤不了我，我出生在火边。
lines.en: Fire cannot hurt me; I was born beside it.

lines.zh: 坠落把我摔歪了，本来就不正。
lines.en: The fall bent me further, and I was already crooked.

lines.zh: 水碰到我的壳，变成蒸汽。
lines.en: Water touches my shell and turns to steam.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，骨头没散。
lines.en: The blast lifted me; my bones held.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，像插在旧木头。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shell like old wood.

lines.zh: 法术在我体内绕，被两半分了。
lines.en: The spell entered me and my halves split it.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，我是拼出来的东西。
lines.en: I cannot starve; I was assembled, not grown.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，凋零的一半笑了。
lines.en: Lightning fell, and my wither half laughed.

lines.zh: 虚空想收我，我还没打够。
lines.en: The void wants me back; I am not finished.
